3662: Issac Dian forms one half of the bumbling thief couple, who seem to cross into everybody's story in one way or another. He's in love with Miria, and they've robbed everything and anything, from doors to the entire Genoard household.
3796: Another eccentric thief, she is the partner and lover of Isaac Dian. Miria wholeheartedly believes and supports everything Isaac says, often even going so far as to mimic his body language.
24592: The primary male protagonist of the series, Mikado Ryugamine is a high school boy who moved to Ikebukuro with the encouragement of his best friend Masaomi in order to search for unusual beings and adventure.
24593: Kida is Mikado Ryuugamine's childhood friend and resident of Ikebukuro. Kida is an easy-going guy and appears foolhardy at times. He is 15 years old and is in class 1-B.
24594: A bespectacled girl who attends the same school as Mikado and Masaomi. She is rather quiet and timid, but seems very close towards Kida and Mikado. She is very busty and cute, which makes her somehow popular, even though she feels uneasy about it.
24595: A man who is always seen to wear sunglasses and a bartender's suit. Although quiet and nondescript while not angered, he has a very short fuse and fights with incredible strength.
24596: A young man who sells information for his own enjoyment. He claims to love the entire human race except for Shizuo Heiwajima, and exhibits said love by putting humans in often miserable conditions and observing their reactions.
24597: A young underground doctor who lives with Celty and is also her lover. He mostly remains indoors and wears his white doctor's coat even when he is not at work. He went to the same primary school as Shizuo and Izaya and finds them interesting, enjoying their fights ...
26832: Originally part of his own gang, Kyohei is now a member of the gang Dollars. He has a nickname "Dotachin" which is used by several characters in the series (mostly Izaya and Erika). One day he got a message to join the gang Dollars.
27885: Erika is a very passionate otaku and manga reader. She and Walker are usually together. She is equally enthusiastic about manga or novel-inspired torture. It is noted she is a "fujoshi" or a yaoi fan. Like Izaya, she calls Kadota "Dotachin".
27886: A classmate of Mikado's. He quits school claiming he has something more important to do with his life. He is very obsessed to his 'true love' who has scar on her head; revealing his psychopathic behaviours. He seems to rely on his sister's money for that.

27889: A tall Black Russian who came to the city to help out his Russian friend who runs a sushi shop. His real name is Semyon but everyone just calls him by the name, "Simon".
27890: Like his female friend and companion, Erika, Walker is a very passionate otaku and manga reader. He and Erika are nearly always together. He also likes to perform torture by letting the victim choose a light novel or manga, and carrying out the contents. He seems to be carefree.
28331: Celty is a Dullahan from Ireland who came to Japan looking for her stolen head. Her motorcycle is actually a horse in disguise. She has no heart and perceives surroundings via unknown sensors that are not located on the head.
29207: Tom Tanaka is an old friend and senpai of Shizuo Heiwajima. He works as a debt collector, and later becomes Shizuo's employer. Tom is usually seen walking around in a suit, but his clothing and his hair don't make him look too formal.
29209: A motorcycle cop with the police department. In the anime, he is known to chase after criminals viciously and has caused accidents and injuries among bystanders during his chases.
29428: A man with an eccentric personality who is Shinra's father. His behaviour is odd to the point that he wears a Gas Mask, he says: "Tokyo air is very filthy." and that's the reason why he wears it. He has also a habit of spinning a pen in his right hand.
29429: One of the three Vice Presidents of the Official Fan Club of Hijiribe Ruri. A buddy to Kyohei and knows Kaztano well since he gets his concert tickets from him. He often drives his friends around in his van.
29430: During the Raira Academy entrance exam, Harima Mika sits between Mikado and Seiji and falls in love with Seiji. She immediately begins collecting information about him. Later Seiji saves Mika and Anri from a gang of bullies. Mika then starts to stalk Seiji.
29673: Kamichika Rio is a female classmate of Kida Masaomi. She is one of Orihara Izaya's victims and almost commited suicide.
30226: A former student of Raira Academy, moved to another high school last semester because of the rumor that she and Nasujima are dating. Her father, Niekawa Shuji is a reporter working for a small magazine.
30227: A teacher at Raira Academy. Rumors circulate that he and Haruna were dating.
30299: Is a little kid that hangs around the Dollars gang place. Helps in episode 6 Erika, Kyohei, Togusa and Walker to find Kaztano by identifying the car that took him.
30300: Kaztano is person that is important to Togusa as he was the one who got him first place tickets to his favorite Idol Ruri Hijiribe, which were quite hard to obtain. It is believed that Kaztano is an Italian foreigner.

30623: Mairu is one of Izaya's younger sisters. She has a twin named Kururi. Like her brother, she's a troublemaker at school and introduces herself as liking to read encyclopedias, manga, and adult magazines.
30624: Kururi is one of Izaya's younger sisters. She has a twin sister named Mairu. Unlike her more outgoing sister, Kururi is shy and softspoken.
30671: A reporter who writes for the Tokyo Incidents. featuring weird events or noteworthy societies in Tokyo. Because of a planned special,​ he comes to Ikebukuro with the intention of doing research on various topics such as who is regarded to be the strongest on the streets.
30782: Aoba is 1st year student in Raira Academy. He has a bright personality and is always seen smiling, but has also a darker side to him. He's described as being akin to "a younger version of Izaya Orihara".
30831: A popular idol. Before becoming an idol, she was originally a makeup artist and was in charge of Kasuka's vampire makeup in his debut film Vampire Ninja Carmilla Saizou.
31198: Apparently part of the Dollars gang.
31200: One of the trio who goes around kidnapping people for experimentation.
31203: Goes to school with Kida and Mikado and is a member of the Dollars gang. He is thought to be a bit of a rebel, but actually spends most of his time alone, composing music on his harmonica.

31647: The daughter of Mikiya Awakusu and the granddaughter of Dougen Awakusu.
32358: One of Awakusu-kai's executives and also one of the youngest (about 30). He's unique among the yakuza members featured in this series in that he always uses the honorific speech (except for when he is talking to his subordinates).
32359: A Yellow Scarves member that picking on Shingen when he just arrives to Ikebukuro. He and his gang was chased away by Celty after he snaps away her PDA.

32869: A high-ranking member of Awakusu-kai. He's also a very remarkable fighter, as he and his partner Aosaki can defeat the powerful Vorona and Slon with ease.
33014: Older brother of Kuronuma Aoba, does not like his younger brother at all. Aoba had always acted all smart and appeared highly aware of other people's needs, which somehow never failed to stir a weird kind of annoyance in Ran.

39374: A Russian assassin who works with Vorona.

89417: Shingen's new wife and stepmother to Shinra. She appears to be as obsessed with surgery as her husband is.
140694: Kujiragi is shown to be a very quiet and composed individual who rarely shows emotion. Despite her manipulation skills, she is a terrible liar when doing so face to face. Despite her name being Kujiragi Kasane, it is not her actual real name.
253293: Hiroto Shijima is introduced as the second-in-command of a drug cartel names Heaven's Slave that primarily deals with a very unstable and powerful drug of the same name. Hiroto is one of two major antagonists introduced in the ninth light novel.

258765: Denis is the owner and chef of the Russia Sushi restaurant and an old friend of Simon.
